title: native_log_child_main waits on a 2 s wall-clock sleep in a test
trigger: cargo test runs native_log_stream_swallows_canary with a tdjson library present
effect: test breaks the 'no sleeps or wall-clock waits in tests' rule and can pass before TDLib has logged the canary (vacuous 'secured' pass on a slow machine)
fix: have the child wait on a deterministic signal (td_receive of the getTextEntities answer, which TDLib sends after it has logged) instead of sleeping
